title: A focused Bihar agriculture agenda lands faster by sequencing **4** steps from early productivity gains to scaled market and delivery reform

phases.title: Early productivity gains create the proof of value needed to build farmer confidence and delivery momentum
phases.body: Start with interventions that raise output quickly in priority geographies, giving the program visible evidence before broader system change begins.

phases.title: Diversification follows once productivity improves, reducing concentration risk and expanding income pathways
phases.body: Use the initial delivery footprint to introduce higher-value crop pathways where production conditions support them, rather than launching diversification without a performance base.

phases.title: Market access scales the value of farm gains by connecting higher output and new crop mix to stronger demand channels
phases.body: Strengthen aggregation, buyer linkages, and market coordination after farm-level gains emerge so increased production converts into realized farmer returns.

phases.title: Execution systems sustain gains by making the full model repeatable across districts instead of pilot-dependent
phases.body: Codify delivery routines, partner roles, and performance tracking so productivity, diversification, and market interventions expand through a durable statewide operating model.
